chunks: Ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

Any woman who sees purity while she is able to perform ghusl during the time of a salat, but is negligent regarding it until the time of another salat enters, then she must make up that salat which she neglected. But if she sees purity during the time of a salat and begins preparing for that, and the time of the salat passes and the time of another salat enters upon her, then no make-up is due from her, and she performs the salat whose time has entered.

key_terms.الطُّهْرَ: ritual purity after the end of menstruation or a similar state
key_terms.فَفَرَّطَتْ: she was negligent or fell short in acting within the prayer time
key_terms.قَضَاءُ: making up an obligation after its time has passed
key_terms.وَقْتُ: the legally prescribed time of the salat

ai.seo_question: If a woman becomes pure during salat time but delays ghusl until the next prayer time, does she have to make up the missed prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who becomes pure from menstruation or a similar state during the time of salat. If she negligently delays ghusl until the next prayer time enters, she must perform qada' of the missed salat; but if she was occupied in preparing for purification without negligence, then no qada' is required.
